qe: Choose the correct verb: “She ___ to school by bus every day.”
qh: सही क्रिया चुनिए: “She ___ to school by bus every day.”
e: The singular subject “she” takes “goes” in the simple present tense.
eh: एकवचन कर्ता “she” के साथ सामान्य वर्तमान काल में “goes” आता है।

qe: Choose the correct article: “He is ___ honest officer.”
qh: सही article चुनिए: “He is ___ honest officer.”
e: “Honest” begins with a vowel sound because its h is silent, so “an” is used.
eh: “Honest” में h मौन है और शब्द स्वर-ध्वनि से शुरू होता है, इसलिए “an” प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Complete the sentence: “Good learners depend ___ regular practice.”
qh: वाक्य पूरा कीजिए: “Good learners depend ___ regular practice.”
e: The standard expression is “depend on” something or someone.
eh: मानक प्रयोग “depend on” है, अर्थात किसी पर या किसी चीज़ पर निर्भर होना।

qe: Choose the correct passive form: “The workers built the bridge in 2020.”
qh: सही passive रूप चुनिए: “The workers built the bridge in 2020.”
o: The bridge was built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge is built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge had build by the workers in 2020.
The workers were built the bridge in 2020.
The bridge built the workers in 2020.
oh: The bridge was built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge is built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge had build by the workers in 2020.
The workers were built the bridge in 2020.
The bridge built the workers in 2020.
e: The simple past active changes to “was/were + past participle”; “bridge” is singular, so use “was built.”
eh: Simple past active का passive “was/were + past participle” होता है; “bridge” एकवचन है, इसलिए “was built” सही है।
oe: The bridge was built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge is built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge had build by the workers in 2020.
The workers were built the bridge in 2020.
The bridge built the workers in 2020.

qe: Choose the correct reported speech: She said, “I am tired.”
qh: सही reported speech चुनिए: She said, “I am tired.”
o: She said that she was tired.
She said that I am tired.
She says that she was tired.
She told that she is tired.
oh: She said that she was tired.
She said that I am tired.
She says that she was tired.
She told that she is tired.
e: With a past reporting verb, “am” normally backshifts to “was,” and “I” changes to “she” to match the speaker.
eh: भूतकालीन reporting verb के बाद “am” सामान्यतः “was” हो जाता है और वक्ता के अनुसार “I” बदलकर “she” होता है।
oe: She said that she was tired.
She said that I am tired.
She says that she was tired.
She told that she is tired.

qe: Choose the correct conjunction: “___ it was raining, the match continued.”
qh: सही conjunction चुनिए: “___ it was raining, the match continued.”
e: “Although” introduces a contrast: the rain did not prevent the match from continuing.
eh: “Although” विरोध दर्शाता है: बारिश के बावजूद मैच जारी रहा।

e: “Abundant” means plentiful and is the opposite of “scarce,” which means limited or insufficient.
eh: “Abundant” का अर्थ प्रचुर है; यह सीमित या अपर्याप्त अर्थ वाले “scarce” का विलोम है।

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning to “cautious.”
qh: “Cautious” के सबसे निकट अर्थ वाला शब्द चुनिए।
e: “Cautious” means careful to avoid danger or mistakes.
eh: “Cautious” का अर्थ खतरे या गलती से बचने के लिए सावधान रहना है।

e: An exclamation mark is appropriate for a sentence expressing strong feeling or admiration.
eh: प्रबल भावना या प्रशंसा व्यक्त करने वाले वाक्य के अंत में विस्मयादिबोधक चिह्न उचित है।

qe: Read: “Mina waters the seedlings each morning. She keeps the soil moist but avoids flooding the pots.” Why does Mina avoid flooding the pots?
qh: पढ़िए: “Mina waters the seedlings each morning. She keeps the soil moist but avoids flooding the pots.” मीना गमलों में पानी भरने से क्यों बचती है?
o: The seedlings need moisture, not waterlogged soil
The seedlings grow only in dry sand
oh: पौधों को नमी चाहिए, जलभराव वाली मिट्टी नहीं
पौधे केवल सूखी रेत में उगते हैं
पानी पौधों की हर वृद्धि रोकता है
वह केवल रात में पानी देती है
e: The passage says she keeps soil moist but avoids flooding, so the seedlings need moisture without waterlogging.
eh: अनुच्छेद कहता है कि वह मिट्टी नम रखती है पर पानी से भरने नहीं देती; पौधों को नमी चाहिए, जलभराव नहीं।
oe: The seedlings need moisture, not waterlogged soil
The seedlings grow only in dry sand
